title: Recovery Billed on a Vehicle and What It Adds to a Claim Opened on It
content:
Where a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan was attended at the roadside shortly before the loss was reported, what that attendance was billed at is added last to the figure the claim is opened at.

- Where a callout on the roadside cover the vehicle carries was completed in the month before the report and the vehicle was towed, the whole of the recovery billed on the completed callouts on that cover in that month is added.
- Where a callout was completed on that cover in that month and the vehicle was not towed, half of the recovery billed on them in that month is added.
- Where no callout was completed on that cover in that month, nothing is added for recovery.

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures)

Suppose 300 was billed on the callouts completed on that cover in the month before the report.

| Callout completed on that cover in the month before | Vehicle towed | Added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 300 |
| yes | no | 150 |
| no | — | nothing |

A callout that was not completed — one cancelled, or standing on the cover in any other state — is counted neither towards the readings nor towards what was billed. Where several callouts were completed in that month, what is added is measured on the whole of the recovery billed on them in the month, not on the last of them alone; and a towing distance of nothing recorded against every completed callout in the month means the vehicle was not towed.

### Where the facts come from

The callouts, the towing recorded against them and the amounts they were billed at are read from the Keyturn Roadside Assistance cover the vehicle carries, taken over the month before the report and counting only callouts recorded as completed on that cover.
